embedding_session.completed.trigger: The borrower finishes the Hub connection flow.
embedding_session.completed.action: Fetch the session and its connection IDs. Completion does not mean underwriting is complete.

connection.action_required.trigger: A connection needs borrower action, such as renewed authorization.
connection.action_required.action: Fetch the connection and start an authorized Hub reauthorization flow; do not retry credentials yourself.

connection.status_changed.trigger: Connection authorization, availability or collection status changes.
connection.status_changed.action: Reconcile status, data_status, freshness and consent before using source data.

origination.action_required.trigger: An assessment pauses for documents, consent or another explicit requirement.
origination.action_required.action: Read requirements and supply the requested input; a submission receipt is not an approval.

origination.status_changed.trigger: Origination processing enters an operational state, including waiting_for_credits or explicit cancellation.
origination.status_changed.action: Read current status and requirements. Follow the specific completion/failure events for terminal outcomes.

origination.completed.trigger: Underwriting processing finishes and a risk package is available.
origination.completed.action: Fetch the origination and risk package. Completed includes approve, decline and review recommendations; it is not a lending approval.

origination.failed.trigger: Underwriting ends without a successful result.
origination.failed.action: Read failure.code and request_id, correct the cause, and use a new command only for an intentional new assessment.

risk_package.created.trigger: A new immutable Insights or Signal risk package is committed.
risk_package.created.action: Read the package, completeness, dimensions, evidence and policy results with results:read and the required product entitlement.

monitor.status_changed.trigger: Monitoring configuration or lifecycle changes, including active, paused, requires_action, waiting_for_credits, stopped or failed.
monitor.status_changed.action: Fetch the monitor. Paused or blocked monitoring must not be interpreted as a clean risk evaluation.

monitoring_run.completed.trigger: A monitoring evaluation finishes as completed or partial.
monitoring_run.completed.action: Fetch the run, sources, limitations, deal snapshot and risk package. Partial coverage is explicit.

monitoring_run.failed.trigger: A monitoring evaluation terminates as failed or skipped without a new risk conclusion.
monitoring_run.failed.action: Inspect the run failure and current monitor. Preserve the previous result; do not treat this as an all-clear.

alert.created.trigger: A policy condition becomes an open monitoring alert.
alert.created.action: Fetch severity, rule, evidence and package references. Start your own intervention workflow; this API does not manage lender cases.

alert.resolved.trigger: Fresh comparable evidence satisfies the policy condition for a previously open alert.
alert.resolved.action: Fetch the resolved alert and package. A delivery retry or manual acknowledgment does not resolve risk.

export.ready.trigger: An export finishes and can be downloaded.
export.ready.action: Fetch the export and request a short-lived download link before expiry. The webhook contains no file or signed URL.

export.failed.action: Read failure and correct format, input or size constraints before requesting a new export.

data.updated.trigger: New normalized data is available for a connection.
data.updated.action: Resume the normalized-data change feed. resource_version identifies the updated connection, not a count of rows.

document.status_changed.trigger: Document processing or access status changes.
document.status_changed.action: Fetch the document and inspect available, rejected or restricted status and failure before using it.

billing.payment_updated.trigger: A funding payment changes state, for example pending, succeeded, failed or returned.
billing.payment_updated.action: Owners with billing:read reconcile the payment; a pending payment is not spendable credit.

billing.transaction_posted.trigger: An immutable funding, usage, adjustment or refund ledger transaction is posted.
billing.transaction_posted.action: Read the transaction and billing summary. Reconcile by transaction ID, never by webhook arrival order.

deal_snapshot.created.trigger: A new immutable lender-supplied deal snapshot is accepted.
deal_snapshot.created.action: Read its sequence and effective time. This records lender input; it does not rerun historical underwriting.
